Package arztis.econnector.rest.model.fhir

Class FhirPractitioner

java.lang.Object
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Base
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.BaseResource
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Resource
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.DomainResource
org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Practitioner
arztis.econnector.rest.model.fhir.FhirPractitioner
All Implemented Interfaces:
ca.uhn.fhir.model.api.IElement, java.io.Serializable, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IAnyResource, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBase, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseHasModifierExtensions, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IBaseResource, org.hl7.fhir.instance.model.api.IDomainResource
public class FhirPractitioner
extends org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Practitioner
This class is used to pass details to query health care providers (GDA), which can use ELGA. The class attributes restrict the search. It is important to restrict the search of health care providers as much as possible to enable best possible return values.
Furthermore it can be used to create parts of CDA R2 document.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth

    • addName

      public void addName​(java.lang.String given, java.lang.String family, java.lang.String prefix, java.lang.String suffix)
      The details about the person to search. Details like given and family name will be used to search for the health care provider.
      Parameters:
      given - health care provider's given name
      family - health care provider's family name
      prefix - health care provider's title before the name. It isn't used to restrict search
      suffix - health care provider's title after the name. It isn't used to restrict search

    • getHl7CdaR2Pocdmt000040Person

      public static org.ehealth_connector.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040Person getHl7CdaR2Pocdmt000040Person​(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Practitioner practitioner, org.ehealth_connector.common.hl7cdar2.POCDMT000040Person person)
      Creates POCDMT000040Person of passed Practitioner.
      This method extracts names of passed Practitioner and added to passed POCDMT000040Person. If person is null a new instance of POCDMT000040Person is created.
      Parameters:
      practitioner - to be extracted
      person - CDA R2 element to add
      Returns:
      POCDMT000040Person with added details.
